text: Steenbarger: no, the trigger carries no volume test, and oneil and minervini are right that my method cares. day_vol 0.51 on a break is a potential upthrust until it proves itself (C5, R3). I concede the condition, not the name: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.13 is on the broken Creek, my most conservative entry (C4, C7), W and D HH/HL. Answer: make the trigger a sign-of-strength bar, h1_close_above:bar_high with vol_x_ge:1.2 (C12, R6), and the break must hold outside the old range. SUPPORT holds. Wrong if a daily close below structure_shift_ref, back inside the old range.
